annotations.title: Read AI product comparisons by task

description: Read published task/industry product comparisons: scoped positions, reasons, evidence, use cases, limitations and pagination. For a company shortlist or a detailed vendor comparison, start with find_ai_companies, then get_company for company/product facts. This tool accepts an English business problem or task and an optional industry; each scope previews up to three products with company IDs and follow-up calls. Positions belong to their scope. Preserve the requested industry and constraints, verify complete product fit, and keep missing coverage explicit.

industry.description: Optional requested industry ID, slug or English name, e.g. healthcare, finance or logistics. Recognizable industries in the query are also retained; conflicting or multiple industries require selection.

limit.description: Number of matching leaderboard scopes (1–5), each previewing up to three products. These scopes do not form a combined ranking.

offset.description: Row offset. Use nextOffset from the previous response.

query.description: English business problem, workflow or task, e.g. 'companies that can automate customer support emails and live chat' or 'vendors that answer phone calls and book appointments'. Translate non-English requests while preserving their requirements. Use search_companies for company names or concise capability keywords.
